## 更新内容

HagimiMonitor 1.5.5 带来电源模块三页式深度诊断、外接显示器控制可靠性重构、内存带宽与分项功耗遥测，以及功率流向图的渲染架构升级。感谢 @zhaojiseng 在 #105 中贡献的面板性能优化与分项功耗方案（已整合进本版本）。

> 🙏 Thanks to @zhaojiseng for the panel performance optimization and split power telemetry work in #105 (integrated into this release).

HagimiMonitor 1.5.5 brings three-page in-depth power diagnostics, a reliability rework for external display control, memory bandwidth and split power telemetry, and a render-architecture upgrade for the power flow diagram.

## 🇨🇳 更新内容

### ✨ 新功能
- **电源展开区升级为「拓扑 / 健康 / 供电」三页**：电池健康类指标独立成页，设置页实时预览同构联动，指标开关随分页自动过滤。
- **电芯深度健康指标**：新增电芯化学容量（Qmax）、电芯内阻、温控限充时长、满电驻留时间四项诊断指标（默认关闭，可在设置 → 电源明细中开启）。
- **内存总线带宽**：内存模块新增实时带宽指标，支持面板明细与菜单栏展示。
- **分项功耗遥测**：电源明细与菜单栏新增屏幕功耗、GPU 功耗。
- **菜单栏新增屏幕刷新率指标**。
- **媒体键目标选择**：可直接指定媒体键控制哪一台外接显示器。
- **辅助功能授权引导**：新增拖拽授权引导卡片，辅助功能权限授予流程更直观。

### ⚡ 优化与体验
- **外接显示器 DDC 控制可靠性重构**：逐属性能力探测（控制项与显示器实际能力匹配）、写入后确认读取、连接身份绑定与中断后自动恢复；新增诊断日志，硬件兼容问题有据可查；DDC 不支持的显示器自动回退 Gamma 软件调光。
- **功率流向图渲染服务驱动**：流向动画迁移至 Render Server，主线程动画占用降至 0；流向随充/放电方向自动反转，汇聚点呼吸光晕。
- **全宽对称排版**：明细区移除额外缩进，统一 10pt 对称全宽；网络与电源行头药丸像素级对齐，消除数值位数变化导致的推挤。
- **菜单栏动画按需降频**：面板展开期间菜单栏图标动画降至 30fps 并消除常驻循环动画；菜单栏指标改读采样管线已发布数据，不再于主线程触发采样。

### 🛠 问题修复
- 修复内存压力格不按压力等级着色的问题。
- 修复显示器控制滑杆旋钮下半部分被裁剪的问题。

## 🇺🇸 English Release Notes

### ✨ New
- **Power panel now spans three pages — Topology / Health / Supply**: battery health metrics live on their own page; the settings preview mirrors the same structure with per-page metric toggles.
- **Deep cell health metrics**: four new diagnostics — cell chemical capacity (Qmax), cell internal resistance, thermal-throttling duration, and time at high state-of-charge (off by default; enable them in Settings → Power details).
- **Memory bus bandwidth**: the memory module gains a live bandwidth metric, available in the detail grid and the menu bar.
- **Split power telemetry**: Display and GPU power are now available in the power details and the menu bar.
- **Display refresh rate**: new menu bar metric.
- **Media key target selector**: choose exactly which external display your media keys control.
- **Accessibility permission guide**: a new drag-and-drop guide card makes granting the Accessibility permission more straightforward.

### ⚡ Improved
- **DDC control reliability rework**: per-attribute capability probing (controls match what each display actually supports), write-then-read-back confirmation, connection identity binding, and automatic recovery after interruptions. A new diagnostics log makes hardware compatibility issues traceable; displays without DDC support automatically fall back to Gamma software dimming.
- **Power flow diagram driven by the render server**: flow animations now run on the Render Server, bringing main-thread animation cost to zero; flow direction reverses with charge/discharge, with a breathing glow at the junction.
- **Full-width symmetric layout**: detail grids drop extra indentation in favor of 10pt symmetric full-width alignment; network and power row-header pills are pixel-aligned, eliminating jitter from digit-width changes.
- **On-demand menu bar throttling**: menu bar icon animations drop to 30fps while the panel is open, and permanently repeating animations were removed; menu bar metrics now read published sampler data instead of triggering sampling on the main thread.

### 🛠 Fixed
- Fixed memory pressure cells not being colored by pressure level.
- Fixed the lower half of external display slider knobs being clipped.
